rules: An active waiver MUST name a human owner, rationale, risk, compensating controls, created and expiry dates (<= 180 days).
The release gate rejects active waivers that are expired, ownerless, or owned by UNASSIGNED.
Technical-debt and deprecation entries MUST name an owning role and a target version or review date.

technical_debt.title: Copy-on-write route registry is O(n) per write
technical_debt.detail: Kept deliberately: copy-on-write is a hardened 4.2.0 invariant. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md OPT-1.

technical_debt.title: HMAC (shared-key) artifact signatures and operator tokens
technical_debt.detail: Replace with asymmetric verification once a KMS / Sigstore decision exists (RR-02, RR-03).

technical_debt.title: Idempotency cache not included in snapshots
technical_debt.detail: Fencing prevents stale re-execution across restart; exact replay response is not preserved (RR-08).

deprecations.title: Loose SPIFFE path characters
deprecations.detail: Path segments outside [A-Za-z0-9._-], uppercase scheme and empty query/fragment are now refused (SPIFFE ID spec). Peers emitting such IDs must be fixed; no compatibility shim is provided.
